Class DataStore

java.lang.Object
com.uni.storage.DataStore
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class DataStore extends Object implements Serializable
Singleton holding all in-memory state and persistence. The single instance can be saved/loaded via Java object serialization.
